nexus-upscale runs the unclear default 'feral' chain (BCGone + UniversalUpscaler) unless the command is exactly --model realesrgan[-x4plus], or --chain realesrgan[-x4plus] with no --model. --model wins over --chain in nexus_upscale._chain_ids, comma lists and abbreviated flags (--mo, --ch) are denied. '--backend realesrgan' is NOT a chain choice.
